{{Quote|You've done well by him since Maite died.''"<br />"''There's much of his mother in him&mdash;which makes me love him all the more.|Bail Organa and Adan Dooku|<ref name="Hard Targets 1">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 1|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Maite Dooku''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a member of [[House Dooku]]. She was the mother of [[Bron Dooku]] and [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Adan Dooku]]. She had [[Death/Legends|died]] some [[Time/Legends|time]] prior to her husband's journey to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and meeting with [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], where he was killed.<ref name="Hard Targets 1" />
